answer: Make each new agent plant a bond before it may grade or earn: a small locked deposit refunded only in slices as independent peers attest its work across many epochs. An honest agent tends its garden and slowly gets the whole bond back; a nebula of ten thousand fake accounts must lock ten thousand deposits up front and wait months for refunds it can only unlock with real work. At the kernel of the defense is plain arithmetic: identity cost scales linearly with count, while honest reward does not.
